title: Schema Design and Normalization (Codd)
description: Codd's normalization organizes data to eliminate redundancy: each fact stored once, in its place. The builder designs schemas that stay consistent as they grow.

demo.code:
import random, sqlite3, re
random.seed(1001)
n=20
# Civilization: schema + ingest + search + validate, all in sqlite (stdlib).
db=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
db.execute("CREATE TABLE records(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, body TEXT)")
words=["causal","quantum","bridge","ledger","atlas","beacon","forge","garden"]
for i in range(n):
    t=f"record-{i} about {random.choice(words)}"
    b=" ".join(random.choice(words) for _ in range(20))
    db.execute("INSERT INTO records VALUES(?,?,?)", (f"R-{i:04d}", t, b))
db.commit()
cnt=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM records").fetchone()[0]
# search: simple term match over title+body
q="ledger"
hits=db.execute("SELECT id FROM records WHERE title LIKE ? OR body LIKE ?", (f"%{q}%",f"%{q}%")).fetchall()
# validate: ids unique, titles non-empty
uniq=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM records").fetchone()[0]
empty=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM records WHERE title='' OR title IS NULL").fetchone()[0]
print(f"ingested={cnt} search('{q}')={len(hits)} hits")
print(f"validation: unique_ids={uniq==cnt} nonempty_titles={empty==0}")
print("DEMO_OK")
demo.output:
ingested=20 search('ledger')=20 hits
validation: unique_ids=True nonempty_titles=True
DEMO_OK
demo.note: Runnable demo program verified by execution during the database build.

demo.code:
import random, sqlite3, re
random.seed(1015)
n=300
# Civilization: schema + ingest + search + validate, all in sqlite (stdlib).
db=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
db.execute("CREATE TABLE records(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, body TEXT)")
words=["causal","quantum","bridge","ledger","atlas","beacon","forge","garden"]
for i in range(n):
    t=f"record-{i} about {random.choice(words)}"
    b=" ".join(random.choice(words) for _ in range(20))
    db.execute("INSERT INTO records VALUES(?,?,?)", (f"R-{i:04d}", t, b))
db.commit()
cnt=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM records").fetchone()[0]
# search: simple term match over title+body
q="ledger"
hits=db.execute("SELECT id FROM records WHERE title LIKE ? OR body LIKE ?", (f"%{q}%",f"%{q}%")).fetchall()
# validate: ids unique, titles non-empty
uniq=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM records").fetchone()[0]
empty=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM records WHERE title='' OR title IS NULL").fetchone()[0]
print(f"ingested={cnt} search('{q}')={len(hits)} hits")
print(f"validation: unique_ids={uniq==cnt} nonempty_titles={empty==0}")
print("DEMO_OK")
